[500+ NPCs] Music Festival Tycoon
Music Festival Tycoon: build your own music festival on Roblox! Book RARE artists, pack the crowd, and cash in to run the biggest festival on the block!
🎵 BIG UPDATE DROP!🎵
🎪 Bigger crowds: 500+ fans at 60 FPS (on most devices)!
💖 HAPPY FANS = BIGGER CROWDS! : happy fans spend more and bring friends!
⭐️ NEW Festival Star Ratings: boost your rating for better rewards!

HOW TO PLAY
🎪 Build your festival from the ground up
🎤 Unlock and collect RARE artists to perform
🎸 Choose your vibe: Rock, Hip Hop, EDM, Country, and K-Pop
🧢 Customize your merch, food, stages, and more
⭐️ Compete with players to create the ultimate music festival
👍Like, ⭐️ Favorite, and turn on 🔔Notifications so you never miss an update!
📱Play on desktop, phone, tablet, and console.
